title: Cobras Rally for 4–1 Win! Four Unanswered Goals Dominate the AlliBladers - 11-13-25
description:
Globo Gym King Cobras D vs. AlliBladers — Game #4839
Final Score: 4–1 (Cobras Win!)
Date: 11/13/25 • League: BH Adult D
Location: Baptist Health Iceplex Rink 2
